name: Smart Home
intro: Magnetic and EMC components for connected home devices, supporting efficient power management, intelligent control and wireless connectivity in compact designs.

summary.heading: Connecting everyday living through smarter electronics.

designTitle: SUPPORT CONNECTED AND ENERGY-EFFICIENT SMART HOME SYSTEMS
designIntro: Enable efficient power delivery, stable controls and reliable wireless communication.

quality.manufacturing: Controlled production supports consistent component supply for connected appliances, home controls and electronic locks.

needs.title: Support Energy Efficiency
needs.text: Provide component options for low-power and standby operation in connected devices.

needs.title: Enable Wireless Connectivity
needs.text: Support RF circuits and communication interface filtering for connected home products.

systems.title: Thermostat
systems.summary: A thermostat brings sensing, display and connected control together in a compact device.

modules.title: Display Panel
modules.description: The display shows temperature, settings and operating status.
modules.need: Support clean, compact power for the display electronics.

mappings.why: Filter conducted noise on the display supply.
Support a very-light-load auxiliary rail within the selected L2 part’s current rating.
mappings.condition: Verify the auxiliary rail’s load and ripple against the exact L2 part rating. The FECS variants are rated 15–50 mA.

modules.consultation: Confirm panel voltage/current, switching spectrum, allowable ripple and PCB area before selecting a part.

modules.title: Interface
modules.description: The interface connects the controls, display and device electronics.
modules.need: Support clean power and signals between thermostat assemblies.

mappings.why: Filter noise on the identified low-voltage interface path.
Support a very-light-load auxiliary rail within the selected L2 part’s current rating.
mappings.condition: Verify the auxiliary rail’s load and ripple against the exact L2 part rating. The FECS variants are rated 15–50 mA.

modules.consultation: Provide interface type, line rate, signal voltage, power rail and emissions test data for a specific recommendation.

modules.title: Power Management
modules.description: Power management supplies the controls and radio in standby and active modes.
modules.need: Support efficient conversion and stable output as loads change.

mappings.why: Store energy in a compatible low-voltage regulator.
Filter conducted noise on a documented low-voltage supply.

modules.consultation: Confirm converter IC, VIN/VOUT, peak and RMS current, switching frequency, temperature rise and footprint.

systems.title: Smart Coffee Machine
systems.summary: Connected coffee machines combine power switching, user controls and optional tap-to-pair or access features.

modules.title: Power Board
modules.description: The power board feeds the appliance’s control and connected functions.
modules.need: Support stable low-voltage power near switching and motor loads.

mappings.why: Store energy in a compatible low-voltage power-board regulator.

modules.consultation: For an isolated power stage, share the input range, power level and insulation requirements to review transformer options.

modules.title: Connectivity
modules.description: Wireless connectivity supports app controls and machine status.
modules.need: Support a stable radio link in the appliance enclosure.

mappings.why: Support compact RF matching in a documented external antenna network.

modules.consultation: Share the operating band, antenna layout and RF circuit for a matching review.

modules.title: NFC Module
modules.description: The NFC reader exchanges data with nearby tags or devices.
modules.need: Support a stable connection in the assembled reader and antenna layout.
modules.consultation: Provide the NFC reader, mounted antenna geometry, nearby metal and matching-network targets for a 13.56 MHz design review.

componentGuidance.purpose: Support the reader’s EMC filter when matched to the mounted 13.56 MHz antenna.

modules.title: Intelligent Control Board
modules.description: The control board coordinates sensors, displays and appliance functions.
modules.need: Support stable power and reduce noise around control circuits.

mappings.why: Filter conducted noise on a documented control-board supply.

modules.consultation: Share the schematic, clock and radio bands, rail currents, PCB stack-up and EMC test findings for a design review.

systems.title: Keyless Entry Door Lock
systems.summary: Keyless locks rely on dependable low-power control and robust communication in a constrained enclosure.

modules.title: Wireless Communication
modules.description: The radio exchanges access commands and device status.
modules.need: Support connectivity within a compact, battery-powered lock.

mappings.why: Filter conducted noise on the documented radio supply.
Support RF matching in a compatible external antenna network.

modules.consultation: Confirm radio protocol, band, antenna, supply current and board layout before choosing RF parts.

modules.title: Main Control Board
modules.description: The main board reads access inputs and operates the locking actuator.
modules.need: Support stable control power as loads change between standby and actuation.

mappings.why: Filter conducted noise on a documented low-voltage control supply.

modules.consultation: Confirm battery chemistry and voltage, actuator pulse current, sleep budget, transient profile and EMC results.

modules.title: DC-DC Converter
modules.description: The DC-DC converter supplies regulated power to the lock electronics.
modules.need: Support efficient conversion through standby and active loads.

mappings.why: Store energy in a compatible low-voltage regulator.
Filter conducted noise on a documented converter rail.

modules.consultation: Provide converter IC, battery input range, output rails, peak/RMS load, switching frequency, ripple limits and board area.
